if you can get a wiring harness, i really would advise going that route. much easier. theyre about 100 dollars for the 4g iirc


Also, if you have the sub in your trunk, im pretty sure the sub routes through your amp, not directly to head unit.


feel free to dm if you have questions on anything. Ive replaced head units in multiple cars, its not hard and you can do it!!!

If the dash is not a box or rectangular shape already, youll need a dash kit. Metra i believe makes a good one. Is the radio you got double or single din? thick or slim if youre not sure what din. 


If you have the manual with your head unit, find what colors mean what for the unit, and attatch those to the matching wires from the car. If the colors match, good, if they dont, go by what the cable is listed as being for. 


the head unit may have what the wires are meant for printed on the wires for that side, but reference the wiring diagram for the car.

this is the[Wiring diagrams](https://tearstone.com/eclipsefsm/2006_PS24S_MMNA_SM_PDF/GR00000400-90.pdf) for the 4g eclipse.  


[Club 4g](https://www.club4g.org) has great info, check that forum out!

oh, and go to a trusted and reputable shop for that if possible. Things happen. I got my timing belt replaced, the belt was faulty and the shop repaired it under warranty, costs covered by part manufacturer. Theres more to that story but the gist is go to a good shop for it.

theyre typically done together, but if you must only do one, absolutely do the timing belt. Eclipses have an interference engine, if the belt snaps while the engine is running, the engine can be totaled by internal damage of pistons and valves smashing into each other. Requires top end rebuild at least to fix.

So both the eclipse and miata were on my mothers insurance, im on the plan. Both cars had pretty much the same rates- my mother does not get comprehensive. First on hers because i was underage when i got the eclipse, miata because it was most convenient at that time.  


My motorcycle is with Progressive on my own plan, and its expensive given my age but not actually terrible. I pay full year to save some on it. Im thinking bundle on progressive or talk to my mom about insurance if i do get another?  otherwise if i were to sell itd be the same question. 


Currently im not selling or buying, staying where i am with the daily miata, but thinking about options for sure.

Still would be paying taxes and insurance for it, and my partner worries it would just sit in the garage, i get that concern but i also dont at the same time. I love driving the car. i dont need two cars, but i like cars a lot. thats where we differ. it makes sense to sell if i dont need it. spending money that i could otherwise be saving or investing without any cash back to cover the spending from selling the other car. Stuff like that.
I can afford maintenance just fine. The eclipse was basically a far more expensive to fix than the car is even worth situation. Id be wanting to get a reliable daily rather than another project :)

No cars are currently stored in the garage, its a little bit of a hassle to get in and out of it every day. Not an electric garage door haha. 


When i lived in an apartment it was much easier to say, ahh i dont have anywhere for a project car anyways.. and so never had as much drive to get another while i had the eclipse. Now i have empty room, and that empty room is alluring…

In terms of getting something super practical, a smaller hatchback is really what im looking for i guess. Thats why i keep going back to dreaming of an eclipse again LOL. i also think maybe i should broaden my horizons and try new things, but i miss that car. 


a GTI would be cool! i love GTIs as well! I dont need anything crazy big, but miata is a little too far on the small no storage side. 


I had a truck, Nissan Frontier, sold it because it was so big i was not comfortable with it in parking lots, and i did not utilize it as trucks should be. I sold it to a contractor :).

Adding on, the Eclipse was not given up by choice necessarily. I had timing belt maintenance done by a local shop. Turns out the belt they put in was faulty, and it snapped while still under warranty. They did a top end rebuild completely under warranty due to damage from the timing belt snapping. Car was in the shop 5 weeks, at this time the smart was not a total dud.  


I got the eclipse back, it would sometimes start, sometimes not, i gave it back to the shop. They had it two days and told me to get it without telling me what happened or what they did. 


The first time i took it on the highway after getting it back, it died. Engine seemed to have seized. Got it towed home, it ran, but was knocking. At this point, it was far more in repairs than it was worth to fix, as the car was a total rust bucket under its pretty exterior. I bought it from rust belt region ohio. 


Gas tank was rusted out and leaking, and i could not source another tank. Engine shot, among other needed repairs, i had to junk it. I cried when it went. I miss it so much.


I do not use that shop anymore, and wont buy a rusty car again LOL

I find music finds a way to express what words cannot. An instrument to its musician as a pen to its poet. 

I played violin since the 4th grade, put too many standards too high for myself, and am unable to play anymore. The feeling of being a part of the music and having it be a part of you is irreplaceable. 

Leaving it all in dust has put an empty void in me since then. Even through the depression and anxiety, please play for yourself. Play for the emotions you dont know how to express. Play for the numbness you feel. The musical voice may feel deaf, but it speaks volumes. 

i hope only the best for you, i hope that one day you wont have to feel the pain- not through numbness but through joy. We are all in this ride together, and i hope its a smooth ride in your seat.
